_readme: Sales experience centre. Source renders are NOT committed (public repo).

Sources are the design team's original 3D exports (2000 px wide JPEGs) from the shared Drive folder, which replaced the earlier crops re-rendered out of the PDF deck: those were enlarged past their real resolution and read as soft on the page.

Client marks: the developer's logo is on the reception back wall in reception views 1, 2 and 3, and on the facade sign in exterior views 1, 2, 6 and 7. All of those are excluded, not retouched. Reception view 4 carries a faint, unreadable red ghost in the glass door that may be a reflection of the reception logo; it is patched anyway.
Bottom-edge render bars: barista view 2 (10 px), conference view 2 (5 px) and reception view 4 (40 px) are cropped off.
Laptop and monitor logos in the views are the device maker's, not the client's.

cafe-and-lounge.alt: Cafe seating in a sales lounge with a statement chandelier and full-height glazing
cafe-and-lounge.caption: The cafe, planned as the waiting room a walk-in visitor actually wants. Indicative viewpoint.

cafe-servery.note: no client mark; 10 px render bar cropped from the bottom
cafe-servery.alt: Cafe tables on a timber floor beside a coffee counter and pantry, with blinds over full-height glazing
cafe-servery.caption: The coffee counter and pantry behind the cafe, so service never crosses the seating. Indicative viewpoint.

scale-model-and-lounge.note: no client mark; the scale model carries no lettering
scale-model-and-lounge.alt: Project scale model on a timber plinth in a marble-floored lobby, with the cafe and glazed meeting rooms behind
scale-model-and-lounge.caption: The scale model in the arrival sightline, clear of the walking route to the cafe. Indicative viewpoint.

meeting-room-approach.note: possible faint logo reflection in the glass door patched; 40 px render bar cropped from the bottom
meeting-room-approach.alt: Timber slatted wall with a flush door, a glazed meeting-room door and a wall screen beside the scale model
meeting-room-approach.caption: Glazed doors to the meeting rooms open straight off the lobby, past the model. Indicative viewpoint.

conference-room.alt: Twelve-seat conference room with a marble-pattern feature wall and writable wall
conference-room.caption: Conference room, 4800 x 6800 mm, with a writable wall opposite the screen. Indicative viewpoint.

conference-room-window.note: no client mark; 5 px render bar cropped from the bottom
conference-room-window.alt: Conference table with white mesh chairs facing a window with timber blinds and a pool view, glass wall to one side
conference-room-window.caption: The same room looking to the window, with the glazed side onto the lounge. Indicative viewpoint.

meeting-room-one.alt: Six-seat meeting room with a pendant light over the table and a window to one side
meeting-room-one.caption: Meeting room one, 3300 x 5400 mm, seating six around a 1000 x 2100 mm table. Indicative viewpoint.

meeting-room-one-screen-wall.alt: Six-seat meeting table under a dome pendant, facing a wall-mounted screen, with framed art on the side wall
meeting-room-one-screen-wall.caption: Meeting room one from the window end, toward the screen wall. Indicative viewpoint.

meeting-area-three.note: no client mark; heavy render grain on the walls removed with a 3 px median so it fits the budget without a crushed quality setting
meeting-area-three.alt: Small three-seat meeting nook with a round table and cluster pendant light
meeting-area-three.caption: The smallest room, 2100 x 2700 mm: one table, three chairs, for a single negotiation. Indicative viewpoint.

sales-head-cabin.alt: Sales head's cabin with a desk, two visitor chairs and a pendant light over the desk
sales-head-cabin.caption: Sales head's cabin, 2500 x 3400 mm, within sight of the floor it runs. Indicative viewpoint.

workstation-bay.alt: Nine-desk sales workstation bay with linear pendant lights and display shelving
workstation-bay.caption: Nine desks in a 5200 x 5800 mm bay, lit to work in rather than to photograph. Indicative viewpoint.

workstation-bay-storage.alt: Sales desks under linear pendants beside a full-height wall of shelving and timber storage cabinets
workstation-bay-storage.caption: The bay's storage wall: open shelves above, closed cabinets below. Indicative viewpoint.
